displayName: OJ — DLQ arrivals on submissions.dlq sustained > 0 (5 min)

documentation.content: The poison topic `submissions.dlq` has received at least one new message in every 1-minute window for the past 5 minutes — i.e. the worker is dead-lettering submissions at a non-zero rate. Per §8.3 a submission reaches the DLQ only after cycling through the idempotency `max-attempts` reclaim cap, so a sustained non-zero arrival rate means real submissions are failing terminally (not a transient blip). Open the `OJ — DLQ poison topic (submissions.dlq)` dashboard: panel 1 shows arrival rate + topic depth, panel 2 shows the age of the oldest unreplayed message, panel 3 shows per-partition spread. The envelope payload (`submission_id`, `phase`, `last_error`, base64 `raw_event_b64`) is JSON inside the message body — `kcat -C -t submissions.dlq -o -10 -e` is the fastest forensic peek. Common upstream causes: problem-service unreachable for the whole reclaim window, repeated SM pool-exhausted that escapes the carve-out, or a poison input that wedges the agent. Replay (once the underlying issue is fixed) is operator-only — there is no auto-consumer on this topic.
